title: New nasal HCG option!
author: DrCurry

inlineImages.alt: New nasal HCG diet option means no needles!
inlineImages.caption: New nasal HCG diet option means no needles!

bodyHtml:
Did you know that there is no legal way for patients to obtain pharmaceutical-grade, compounded HCG in the state of Ohio unless it is patient-specific, individually compounded and prescribed for an individual patient?

In order to be compliant with regulations and provide the highest-quality HCG for our patients, we see the patient in the office first and prescribe a specific regimen, which is transmitted to a local pharmacy that is licensed in Ohio and Kentucky.  The medication is then specifically compounded in either injectable or nasal form per the patient’s request, and is shipped directly to the patient.

With our new nasal option you can lose weight without the need for needles!
